ranking.reason: Has the strongest independent agentic scores of anything that fits. Artificial Analysis TB2.1 is 79.8 (xhigh), 65.2 (medium), 67.4 (low) and 49.1 (non-reasoning), with tau3-Banking 48.0/47.4/32.2/20.0 and Progress Index 303. It is dense and fits entirely in VRAM, with a decode bound of about 896/13 GB, roughly 65 tok/s. Independent llama-bench gives 42 tok/s for the Q4 build on a 3090-class card, so it should clear 15 tok/s comfortably. Caveats: 3-bit quality loss is unmeasured, and one community tester called 27B at Q3 with quantized KV 'lobotomized' compared with 35B-A3B at Q6 (Qwen3.5 era, opinion). The q8_0 KV decode penalty (#27623) is unresolved at b12407. Context is capped near 64-88k. It is verbose (AA: about 86-110k output tokens per task), so use reasoning_effort medium.

notes:
Method: I read current-knowledge.md, compact-old.json (all 22 records with corrections) and the reviews for artificialanalysis, reddit-18-models, reddit-small-local and benchlm, including their checks. I cross-checked AA values in scratchpad/src/artificialanalysis/own_table.txt. No browsing was needed.

Independent anchors used: AA TB2.1 / tau3. Qwen3.8 xhigh 79.8/48.0 and medium 65.2/47.4; MoVA 56.6/32.0; Qwen3.6 44.9/9.3; K2 7B 44.2/27.6; Gemma 26B 39.0/12.0; Coder-Next 38.2/5.4; Lightning 24.3/8.9; gpt-oss-20b 13.9. Nanbeige TB4.0 29.8 / II 20.4. Bolt 74B TB4.0 0 / AutomationBench 15.5. AA has no page for LFM2.5-24B, Ternary Bonsai, Ornith, Laguna, KAT, Xing, Groot or Mellum, so those rest on vendor claims only.

Left out of the top 10:
- Xing4.0-29B-A4B: all scores self-reported, the vendor's Qwen3.6 comparators were relabelled (corrected), and there is a public report of failed write/edit tool calls.
- LFM2.5-24B-A2B: vendor-only, and its own OpenCode SWE-V is 51.0 against 66.2 for Qwen3.6. Silent tool-call loss (#30490). The licence bars commercial use above USD 10M revenue.
- Ternary Bonsai 2 27B: the only independent quality test regresses against Qwen3.8 (12/47 vs 19/47). Vendor tool-call looping issues.
- Ornith-1.5-9B, KAT-Coder-V2.5-Dev, Laguna XS 2.1 and MiMo-V2.6-9B: vendor-only. Laguna and KAT trail or are contested against Qwen3.6 in their own tables.
- Nemotron 3.5 Lightning: AA TB2.1 24.3.
- gpt-oss-20b: AA TB2.1 13.9.
- Mellum2.1 and the Gemma 4 12B/E4B, Granite, Nano 4B, Bolt E4B and Ministral small models: weak agentic scores.
- Devstral Small 2: 64k only with q4_0 KV.
- DeepSeek-R1 8B: no tool calls.
- gpt-oss-120b: RAM-marginal.
- Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B: superseded.

Placements resting mainly on vendor claims: #6 Bolt (NVIDIA-run table, mixed AA) and #10 Groot.

Every speed figure is inferred: nothing has run on this machine, and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit with CDI must be installed first. Suggested measurement order for an OpenCode tool-call smoke test plus a short agentic A/B: #1, #2, #3, #4, then #6.
